analyst.summary: TVS Motor delivered a genuinely strong FY26 - revenue up 30%, EBITDA margin up to 12.9%, profit up 42% - and posted record Q1 FY27 volumes (16.31 lakh units for the quarter, June sales up 47%) with electric-scooter sales up 237%. Note the quarter's financial results aren't out yet - TVS reports Q1 FY27 earnings on July 21, 2026. Operationally the business is executing well: it leads India's electric-scooter market, exports are recovering strongly in Africa and Latin America, and its financing arm (TVS Credit) is compounding profitably with a record profit. Set against this, the stock trades near 50x earnings - roughly double Bajaj Auto and three times Hero MotoCorp - pricing in a growth rate well above what a normalized, post-subsidy outlook realistically supports, especially with Bajaj's Chetak closing the electric-scooter gap fast and continued cash commitments (a fresh Rs 2,000 crore pledge) flowing into the loss-making, shrinking-revenue UK Norton motorcycle business. Good company, expensive stock: Sell on valuation, not on fundamentals.
